sentences.text:
Dy. Govt. Advocate appearing for State submitted that offence under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471,
120-B of IPC was registered at Police Station-STF District-Bhopal.
It is submitted by him that offence is committed at Jabalpur and documents were also forged here.
It is submitted that entire allegations relate to jurisdiction of District-Jabalpur.
FIR was lodged on 19.04.2018.

At that time,
there was only one STF Court that was at District-Bhopal and there was no notification of Court at Jabalpur.
It is further submitted by him that recently notification No.A/1814(STF)/III-6-5/2014 dated 14.04.2024 has been issued by High Court of Madhya Pradesh designating an STF Court at Jabalpur.
It is submitted that case was sent back by Jabalpur to Bhopal on grounds that when offence was committed, there was no STF Court at Jabalpur.
At that time, there was STF Court at Bhopal only.

It is submitted that since now there is an STF Court at Jabalpur and cause of action and offence is said to have been committed at Jabalpur therefore, direction may be given that case be tried at STF Court Jabalpur and not at Bhopal.
3. Counsel appearing for respondents also supported the contentions made by Dy. Govt. Advocate appearing for State.
4. Heard learned counsel for parties.
5. Territorial Jurisdiction is at Jabalpur.
However, there was no STF Court at Jabalpur at the time when offence was committed, therefore offence was registered and was being tried at STF Court District-Bhopal.

Now, there is a notification of High Court of Madhya Pradesh and STF Court is also available at Jabalpur, therefore, it would be proper to conduct the trial at STF Court, Jabalpur as all the witnesses will be easily available at Jabalpur for deposing in the Case, STF Court available at Jabalpur and further there is also a notification of High Court of Madhya Pradesh with regard to the same.
No purpose will be served in sending the case to STF Court District-Bhopal 6.

Considering aforesaid circumstances of the case, petition is disposed of directing 12t h Additional Sessions Judge, Jabalpur to conduct trial in connection with Crime No.11/2018 registered at STF District-Bhopal.
Court at Jabalpur is further directed to continue the trial from the point, from where STF Court Bhopal has transferred it to Jabalpur.
7. With aforesaid, petition is disposed of.
8. Certified copy as per rules.
